rubric.why: Identifies that temporary storage holds data or instructions only for a short time.
rubric.description: States that data or instructions are held temporarily.
rubric.how: Award for explaining that data or instructions are kept for a short time.

rubric.why: Names a valid example or describes what happens to temporary storage when power is removed.
rubric.description: Names RAM as an example, or states that stored contents are lost when the power is switched off.
rubric.how: Award for naming RAM or correctly describing the loss of contents when power is switched off.

modelAnswer: Temporary storage holds data and instructions for a short time while the computer is processing them.
RAM is an example; its contents are lost when the power is switched off.

items.followUp: Explain software sharing with an example.

rubric.why: Explains that a hardware device or resource is made available for use by more than one computer.
rubric.description: States that several computers can use the same hardware resource or device.
rubric.how: Award for clearly describing hardware being shared among multiple computers.

rubric.why: Provides a suitable example of hardware sharing.
rubric.description: Gives a printer shared by computers as an example.
rubric.how: Award for a clear example of computers sharing a printer.

modelAnswer: Hardware sharing means allowing several computers to use the same hardware device or resource.
For example, computers on a network can share one printer.
